carb.name: Carburetors

spec.This one: Enzo 9 Nov 2026. Two S&S carbs, custom on the 181. Drives a few minutes, then fuel spills, idle dies unless you keep giving it throttle, then it shuts off. Look for E or G cast under S&S SUPER on each body. Super E is 1-7/8 in, Super G is 2-1/16 in.
spec.Means: Bowls overfilling. S&S Super E/G are Harley shorty carbs. They were built for a petcock, not a car pump. Extra fuel dumps into the intake so idle goes full rich. Throttle adds air until the overflow wins.
spec.Pump: Enzo 10 Nov 2026: previous owner took the electric pump off. The car is on a mechanical pump — cam-driven by the engine, not a hand lever. No pump SKU on any ticket. Do not lock a marine mechanical-pump number until the tag is read.
spec.Inlet on paper: IMG_5937 (R SIDE) labels #7 Fuel Inlet. It is the brass barb on the float bowl. Fuel hose clamps onto it. Do not open the bowl to measure pressure. Also on that page: #6 Overflow Tube Fitting, #8 Bowl Vent Hole, #9 Bowl Plug.
spec.Easy: Keep them. Do not rip the custom manifold off for a Rochester. First: measure fuel pressure with the engine running. Tee a gauge into the hose that feeds #7 Fuel Inlet. A mechanical pump does not run key-on / engine-off. Shop practice on Super E/G is about 1.5–2 psi. A typical carb mechanical pump is 4–7 psi, still too much for these Harley needles. Taking the electric off does not fix the flood by itself. Holley 12-804 is 1–4 psi, two outlets (one per carb), page $51.95, preset 2.8 — turn it down. Inlet to that regulator is limited to 7 psi. A stock mechanical carb pump is usually in that band; if the reading is hotter, 12-804 is the wrong style. https://www.holley.com/products/fuel_systems/fuel_pumps_regulators_and_filters/regulators/carbureted_regulators/parts/12-804
spec.Needle: S&S 11-2195, already circled on IMG_5949. Fits Super E and G. Page $19.95. Need two. https://autoplicity.com/8595253-ss-cycle-float-needle
spec.Seat: S&S 11-2465 .160 in inlet seat, already circled on IMG_5949. Fits Super E and G with 11-2195. Page $18.95. Need two. https://www.sscycle.com/shop-by-products/replacement-parts/carburetor-replacement-parts/
spec.O-ring: Seat/bowl plug o-ring 50-8009 is also circled on IMG_5949. Replace it when the seat comes out.
spec.Float: S&S 11-2187 on the same parts list. Shake both — if it sloshes, replace. Page $26.95 each. S&S sheet: top of float 1/8–3/16 in below the bowl gasket surface with the needle spring compressed.
spec.Enrichment: Super E/G have no conventional choke. Fast-idle / enrichment lever. If that lever is up while hot, it stays rich. NAPA 732-1153 choke kit is still on the 2010 ticket with no application — do not assume it is these carbs.
spec.Not easy: One marine Rochester 2-barrel is the stock 181 carb. That needs the original intake back. Custom dual S&S manifold means that is not a bolt-off/bolt-on.
spec.Not: Not an electric pump. Not a locked mechanical pump SKU. Not a locked Rochester / Mercarb / Weber. Not Wix 33003 causing a spill out of the bowl. S&S racing seat 11-2466 is not the circled 11-2465.

spec.This one: Read on the car 9 Nov 2026. Housing opened. No thermostat. Hollow into the engine. Inside is corroded. Enzo: this is the marine 181, not the street version, even though it sits in the Locost. Try cleaning before buying 18-1910.
spec.Marine: Cooling parts are boat. 861493A07 / 18-1910 / Barr 47587 + 60372 are the analog. Buck's EPS print still says industrial/irrigation — that is the paperwork in the folder, not the housing family on the car.
spec.Clean: Yes if gasket faces, thermostat seat, and hose necks are not pitted through. Brass or nylon brush. Aluminum-safe scale remover or vinegar, then rinse and dry. Do not steel-wheel a sealing face — that dishes it. Finger across the gasket path and the stat ledge: if you can feel pits that would leak, the kit is cheaper than doing this twice.
spec.Jacket: Same coolant went through the housing and the block. The 181 block and head are iron. Scale in the jackets is likely. That is not the same as the aluminum housing being eaten through. Not a new engine by itself. Light down the block outlet once the housing is off. Flush and see what comes out. Flakes can clog the JEGS radiator. Coolant type was never invoiced.
spec.Fail: Pits across the gasket path, eaten thermostat ledge, thin or cracked hose neck, junk sender/plug threads → Sierra 18-1910 / Mercury 861493A07. Still the analog. Not bought.

log.text: Enzo 9 Nov 2026: after a few minutes of driving, fuel spills from the carburetor, the engine floods, idle dies unless you keep giving it throttle, then it shuts off. Bowl overfilling. Tag not read. Count the carbs. Do not order the S&S Super E needle from the folder print. Choke kit 732-1153 was bought 30 Dec 2010; application not printed. Fuel pump is not on a ticket.

spec.This one: Enzo 9 Nov 2026. Drives a few minutes, then fuel spills from the carburetor, the engine floods, idle will not hold, rpm drops unless you keep giving it throttle, then it dies. Tag not read.
spec.Means: The bowl is overfilling. Extra fuel dumps into the intake, so idle goes full rich and it stalls. Throttle adds air, so it will still pull until the overflow wins. Spilling out of the carb is the overflow, not a hose weeping on the way there.
spec.Likely: Float taking on fuel (holds a few minutes, then sinks). Needle and seat not sealing. Fuel pressure too high for the needle. A fuel pump is not on any ticket — Locost rear tank is often electric. Measure at the inlet before it floods. Carb needles usually want well under 7 psi. Not locked to a pump SKU.
spec.Choke ticket: NAPA 732-1153 choke kit, 30 Dec 2010, net $19.29. Application not printed. A stuck-closed choke makes it rich from the start. Spill after a few minutes of driving is still a bowl problem first.
spec.Paper: S&S Super E/G prints in the folder circled needle 11-2195 and seat 11-2465. Nothing on those pages says that carb is on this 181. Do not order them for this flood.
spec.Do: Stop running it flooded. Smell the dipstick — raw fuel in the oil from washing the walls. Count how many carbs. Read the tag. Key on, pump on, engine off: if it spills immediately the needle is already open or pressure is wild. If it only spills after it has been running, pull the lid and shake the float. Log it.
spec.Not: Not a locked Rochester / Mercarb / Weber number. Not the S&S Super E. Not Wix 33003 causing a spill out of the bowl.

log.text: Enzo: two S&S carbs, custom on the 181. Harley Super E/G on a car pump. Easy path: keep them. Measure pressure, Holley 12-804 if high (two outlets, page $51.95, inlet limit 7 psi), then circled needle 11-2195 and seat 11-2465 both sides. Shake floats 11-2187. Do not rip the custom manifold for a Rochester. Look for E or G cast on each body.

spec.This one: Enzo 9 Nov 2026. Two S&S carbs, custom on the 181. Drives a few minutes, then fuel spills, idle dies unless you keep giving it throttle, then it shuts off. Look for E or G cast under S&S SUPER on each body. Super E is 1-7/8 in, Super G is 2-1/16 in.
spec.Means: Bowls overfilling. S&S Super E/G are Harley shorty carbs. They were built for a petcock, not a car pump. Extra fuel dumps into the intake so idle goes full rich. Throttle adds air until the overflow wins.
spec.Easy: Keep them. Do not rip the custom manifold off for a Rochester. First: measure fuel pressure at an inlet. Shop practice on Super E/G with a pump is about 1.5–2 psi. A Locost electric pump is usually more than that. Holley 12-804 is 1–4 psi, two outlets (one per carb), page $51.95, preset 2.8 — turn it down. Inlet to that regulator is limited to 7 psi. If the pump is hotter, 12-804 is the wrong style. https://www.holley.com/products/fuel_systems/fuel_pumps_regulators_and_filters/regulators/carbureted_regulators/parts/12-804
spec.Needle: S&S 11-2195, already circled on the folder page. Fits Super E and G. Page $19.95. Need two. https://autoplicity.com/8595253-ss-cycle-float-needle
spec.Seat: S&S 11-2465 .160 in inlet seat, already circled. Fits Super E and G with 11-2195. Page $18.95. Need two. https://www.sscycle.com/shop-by-products/replacement-parts/carburetor-replacement-parts/
spec.Float: S&S 11-2187. Shake both — if it sloshes, replace. Page $26.95 each. S&S sheet: top of float 1/8–3/16 in below the bowl gasket surface with the needle spring compressed.
spec.Enrichment: Super E/G have no conventional choke. Fast-idle / enrichment lever. If that lever is up while hot, it stays rich. NAPA 732-1153 choke kit is still on the 2010 ticket with no application — do not assume it is these carbs.
spec.Not easy: One marine Rochester 2-barrel is the stock 181 carb. That needs the original intake back. Custom dual S&S manifold means that is not a bolt-off/bolt-on.
spec.Not: Not a locked Rochester / Mercarb / Weber. Not Wix 33003 causing a spill out of the bowl. S&S racing seat 11-2466 is not the circled 11-2465.

spec.This one: Enzo 9 Nov 2026. Two S&S carbs, custom on the 181. Drives a few minutes, then fuel spills, idle dies unless you keep giving it throttle, then it shuts off. Look for E or G cast under S&S SUPER on each body. Super E is 1-7/8 in, Super G is 2-1/16 in.
spec.Means: Bowls overfilling. S&S Super E/G are Harley shorty carbs. They were built for a petcock, not a car pump. Extra fuel dumps into the intake so idle goes full rich. Throttle adds air until the overflow wins.
spec.Pump: Enzo 10 Nov 2026: previous owner took the electric pump off. The car is on a mechanical pump — cam-driven by the engine, not a hand lever. No pump SKU on any ticket. Do not lock a marine mechanical-pump number until the tag is read.
spec.Inlet on paper: IMG_5937 (R SIDE) labels #7 Fuel Inlet. It is the brass barb on the float bowl. Fuel hose clamps onto it. Do not open the bowl to measure pressure. Also on that page: #6 Overflow Tube Fitting, #8 Bowl Vent Hole, #9 Bowl Plug.
spec.Easy: Keep them. Do not rip the custom manifold off for a Rochester. First: measure fuel pressure with the engine running. Tee a gauge into the hose that feeds #7 Fuel Inlet. A mechanical pump does not run key-on / engine-off. Shop practice on Super E/G is about 1.5–2 psi. A typical carb mechanical pump is 4–7 psi, still too much for these Harley needles. Taking the electric off does not fix the flood by itself. Holley 12-804 is 1–4 psi, two outlets (one per carb), page $51.95, preset 2.8 — turn it down. Inlet to that regulator is limited to 7 psi. A stock mechanical carb pump is usually in that band; if the reading is hotter, 12-804 is the wrong style. https://www.holley.com/products/fuel_systems/fuel_pumps_regulators_and_filters/regulators/carbureted_regulators/parts/12-804
spec.Needle: S&S 11-2195, already circled on IMG_5949. Fits Super E and G. Page $19.95. Need two. https://autoplicity.com/8595253-ss-cycle-float-needle
spec.Seat: S&S 11-2465 .160 in inlet seat, already circled on IMG_5949. Fits Super E and G with 11-2195. Page $18.95. Need two. https://www.sscycle.com/shop-by-products/replacement-parts/carburetor-replacement-parts/
spec.O-ring: Seat/bowl plug o-ring 50-8009 is also circled on IMG_5949. Replace it when the seat comes out.
spec.Float: S&S 11-2187 on the same parts list. Shake both — if it sloshes, replace. Page $26.95 each. S&S sheet: top of float 1/8–3/16 in below the bowl gasket surface with the needle spring compressed.
spec.Enrichment: Super E/G have no conventional choke. Fast-idle / enrichment lever. If that lever is up while hot, it stays rich. NAPA 732-1153 choke kit is still on the 2010 ticket with no application — do not assume it is these carbs.
spec.Not easy: One marine Rochester 2-barrel is the stock 181 carb. That needs the original intake back. Custom dual S&S manifold means that is not a bolt-off/bolt-on.
spec.Not: Not an electric pump. Not a locked mechanical pump SKU. Not a locked Rochester / Mercarb / Weber. Not Wix 33003 causing a spill out of the bowl. S&S racing seat 11-2466 is not the circled 11-2465.
